sketches.mechanism: Move semantics for non-Copy values: assignment transfers ownership and the previous binding can no longer be used.
sketches.resonance: What is given wholly away cannot answer again to its old name.

sketches.mechanism: An object finalizer can resurrect the object by storing self somewhere reachable during __del__.
sketches.resonance: At the instant of disappearance, a thing can spend its last gesture becoming reachable again.

sketches.mechanism: Nothing is an uninhabited bottom type, so Nothing? has exactly one possible value: null.
sketches.resonance: The impossible, if made nullable, can exist only as absence.
